observations: Photo 0: a large industrial machine in a dusty workshop, teal frame with cream side covers, seen from the feed end.

It has a saddle feed table with a worn, rust-brown metal plate, a sewing head with a row of needles and hooks, thread guides above and a clear plastic guard on top: this is a book thread sewing machine for bookbinding.
Photo 1: side view showing a control panel with coloured push buttons, a red and yellow rotary main switch, an electrical warning sticker, handwheels and a delivery arm to the right.
A small label on the side cover in photo 1 is too small to read; no maker name, model or serial plate is readable in either photo.
Covers have dust, scuffs and some dirt; feed table shows wear and surface rust.
Machine is not shown running; no thread, signatures, manual or accessories are visible.
Watermark 'OYOLAKFOM NIG LTD, posted on Jiji' on both photos; this is the seller's mark.

claims.evidence: No clip of the machine running or sewing a book block; photos 0 and 1 show it idle and dusty.
No maker plate or brand is readable in photo 0 or photo 1.
No clip with sound of the motor running.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are shown in either photo.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be shown in a photo; for an industrial machine it suggests no maintenance record.

risks.risk: Maker and model unknown; a European, Japanese or Chinese book sewing machine differ greatly in value and parts supply.
risks.proof: Close photo of the maker's nameplate with model and serial number, usually on the frame or control cabinet.

risks.risk: Machine may not run or may not sew cleanly: worn needles, hooks, cams or feed.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine running under power and sewing several signatures into a book block, with the output shown.

risks.risk: Electrical control system or motor may be faulty or may need three phase power the buyer does not have.
risks.proof: Photo of the motor rating plate and the open control cabinet, plus the running clip.
risks.if_unproven: as needing motor and electrical repair

risks.risk: Missing change parts, needles, tools and manual.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories and the manual laid out beside the machine.

proof_requests: Close photo of the maker's nameplate showing brand, model and serial number.
Clip of the machine running and sewing signatures into a book block.
Photo of the motor plate and open control cabinet.
Photo of the accessories and manual.
response.reason: The photos show an industrial book thread sewing machine, but its maker and model, which set the price, are not readable and the seller does not name them, so not even a worst case price is possible until the nameplate is shown.
